reasoning_content: All 8 OGC GetCapabilities URLs listed in the guide return 200. The xplanwerk URL was my own guess and returned 404, but it's not part of the guide's list. Let's check the actual capabilities document to confirm it's the real OGC document (not just a 200 from an error page). Also, check the database state, RabbitMQ, MinIO, and the executor.
